force_scale_note: 2026-09-17: switched from the auto quality-gated stance detector (which only found a usable L-side window, 1 trial) to manually-selected stance windows per side, picked visually via code/expt_temp/Insole_vertical_force_calib_window/select_stance_windows.py (5 L-side / 7 R-side trials accepted -- see AB07_manual_stance_selections.csv/AB07_manual_calibration.json in that folder). Verified against real marker peak GRF: raw insole peaks were already near-perfect (-10 to +1%); this gain (near 1.0 on both sides) keeps them there (-8 to -1%), a genuine improvement/wash, not a regression like an earlier, since-superseded manual selection was.
note: AB07 NOEXO OpenCap session (OpenCapData_25f76f3d-...) trial files are mislabeled with an AB08_... prefix instead of AB07_... -- confirmed genuinely AB07 data (sessionMetadata.yaml: subjectID=AB07, mass_kg=64.4, height_m=1.753, matching subject_metadata.csv exactly and NOT matching AB08 62.6kg/1.6256m). Operator typed the wrong subject ID as the trial-name prefix during capture; opencap_aliases maps every canonical NOEXO SLJ trial name to its actual (mislabeled) OpenCap filename. The EXO session does not have this issue.
model_note: 2026-09-21: AB07's EXO-condition scaled marker-based model (AB07_shoe_size_5_EXO_scaled.osim) has 52 markers instead of the study's usual 53 -- LFM5 (left 5th metatarsal) has NO column at all in AB07_EXO_static_markers_PROCESSED.trc (confirmed: not merely NaN, the marker was never recorded for this specific static capture). This is a genuine raw-data gap, independent of and unrelated to the LaiUhlrich2022+Biomech57 model correction (any ScaleTool run against this same TRC, old model or new, would hit the identical gap) -- not a code bug, nothing to fix here. Harmless in practice: IK only uses whatever markers a given trial's own TRC actually has, so this just means AB07's EXO trials get one fewer constraint on the left foot's IK solve, not a crash or a wrong result.
